inputs.label: Your DEAD OR ALIVE Xtreme 3 Scarlet files from your Switch: the folder with the .nsp files (base game, and the 1.0.6 update and DLC if you have them), or the base game's .nsp

prepare.label: Building the game from your files. The first time, it also installs the free build tools (MSYS2 and Python 3.12), and Windows may ask for permission. Takes about an hour and needs about 20 GB free.

exit_codes.20: The game isn't set up yet, or its files are missing. Set it up again on the game's page: choose the folder with your game files, and your prod.keys.
exit_codes.21: This update of DOAX3 Recomp needs the game built again, and that didn't finish. Press Play to try again. What went wrong is in setup.log in the game's folder.

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Borderless fills your screen and lets you switch apps quickly. Fullscreen gives the game the screen to itself. Windowed uses Window size.

settings.label: Window size
settings.help: The window's size in Windowed mode, and the screen resolution in Fullscreen. Borderless always uses your desktop's.

settings.label: 3D resolution
settings.help: What the beach, the hotel and the girls are drawn at. The console's own is 1600 x 900. Higher is sharper and needs a faster graphics card; 4K may run out of memory.

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.help: 60 draws twice as many frames as the console's 30, and 120 four times as many (best on a 120 Hz or faster display). The game keeps its normal speed at every rate.

settings.label: Anti-aliasing
settings.help: SMAA smooths jagged edges of the game image, blending only along them, so textures stay sharp.

settings.label: Texture filtering
settings.help: Anisotropic filtering keeps the sand, floors and water sharp where they're seen at an angle, further into the distance. 16x is the sharpest and costs very little on a dedicated graphics card.

settings.label: Upscaler
settings.help: How the game's 1080p image is scaled to your window or screen. AMD FSR 1 keeps edges sharp; bilinear is plain and soft. The default is FSR 1 on a dedicated graphics card and bilinear on an integrated one.

settings.label: Controller in the background
settings.help: The controller keeps working while another window is in front.

settings.label: Show FPS
settings.help: The frame rate in a corner of the game.

settings.label: Controls
settings.help: Switch controls: the game's A is the right face button and B the bottom one, as on a Switch. Other: A and B are swapped, and X and Y, so A is the bottom button, as on an Xbox controller. Buttons can also be changed one by one in the game's menu (F1).

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: doax3.log from the last start, and setup.log from the build, to attach to a bug report.
